prompt: Everything built only of copper, in every stage of oxidation.

card.name: Verdigris Reach

site.text: A settlement on ordinary level ground, terraced gently so its buildings can step from bright new copper at the centre to deeply weathered green at the edges.

style.text: Everything built only of copper, in every stage of oxidation: bright cut copper, exposed, weathered and oxidized variants, waxed and unwaxed, shading from orange to teal-green.

purpose.text: A showcase home base and gathering place celebrating copper and its oxidation, with workshops and homes.

avoid: Any building material other than copper and its oxidation variants
card.interpretation: You asked for a settlement built only from copper in every stage of oxidation. I took the site as ordinary flat ground, the style as an all-copper palette running from bright orange to oxidized teal, and the purpose as a home base with homes and workshops. No backstory was given, so none was added. Buildings step through the oxidation stages, newest at the centre, most weathered at the edges.

contradictions.issue: Only copper is allowed, but buildings usually need other materials (doors, glass, floors, light).
contradictions.resolution: Copper and its variants carry the walls, roofs, floors, stairs, slabs, doors, trapdoors, bulbs and lightning rods; glass and non-copper items are avoided where possible.

assumptions: Medium size, about 10 buildings' worth of settlement, since none was given.
Purpose taken as home base, since the prompt named none.
Terrain is flat, with no specific site form requested.
Search for a suitable location, since no spot was named.

program.notes: Central gathering hall in bright new copper, with a roof aged to exposed and weathered copper.
Workshop with copper bulb lights and lightning rod chimney; semi-weathered.
Homes each at a different stage of oxidation, from exposed to fully oxidized.
Tall tower fully oxidized, teal-green, topped with lightning rod.
Shrine showing all four oxidation stages in a gradient from floor to spire.
